recognize_zh: 多個未變大的紅血球內含細小的環狀滋養體（藍色細胞質環加紅紫色染色質點），其中一個貼附在紅血球邊緣呈貼邊型（accolé/appliqué form），部分細胞含兩個環狀體，符合惡性瘧原蟲感染。
features: Several normal-sized red cells containing small, delicate ring-form trophozoites with thin blue cytoplasm and red-purple chromatin dots
Some ring forms show double chromatin dots or two parasites per cell
Parasite applied to the red cell margin (accolé/appliqué form) near the bottom of the field
No enlargement of infected cells, Schuffner stippling, pigment, schizonts or gametocytes in this field
Background red cells otherwise unremarkable; low parasitemia estimate not possible from a single field
describe_en: Thin peripheral blood smear shows several non-enlarged red cells containing small, delicate ring-form trophozoites, including forms with double chromatin dots, a red cell with more than one parasite, and a peripherally applied (accolé) form. Infected cells lack stippling, and no mature trophozoites, schizonts or crescent-shaped gametocytes are seen in this field. In a traveler returning from Africa with cyclic fever, findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum malaria; parasitemia should be quantified on the thin film.

ddx.vs: Babesia shows pleomorphic intraerythrocytic rings, occasionally extracellular forms and tetrads, without accolé forms or pigment, and occurs after tick exposure.
Vivax and ovale parasitize enlarged, Schuffner-stippled red cells and show amoeboid or compact trophozoites rather than fine accolé rings.
P. malariae infects normal-sized cells but shows thicker rings, band-form trophozoites and rosette schizonts with low parasitemia.

ddx.dx: Platelet or stain precipitate overlying red cells
ddx.vs: Superimposed platelets and precipitate lack the ring-shaped cytoplasm with a discrete chromatin dot and lie in a different focal plane.
